{{Quote|Once we're clear, we'll have some Corellian brandy I've been saving &mdash;you and I.|Gar Stazi, to Nict|<ref name="Legacy 21" />}}
'''Nict''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] serving the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in [[130 ABY]]. During the [[Battle of Caamas]], the admiral's ''[[Pride of Corellia]]'' and other ships of the [[Core Fleet|fleet]] were unable to escape from [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] and into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] due to the [[Fel Empire]] sabotaging the lanes. The old friend of Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] initially protested his risky suggestion of using the routes known to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], but Stazi was adamant and said he had been saving some [[Corellian brandy/Legends|Corellian brandy]] that he would share with Nict when the fleet was safe. After Stazi and Nict spoke, the Empire destroyed the ''Pride of Corellia'', [[Death/Legends|killing]] Nict.<ref name="Legacy 21" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nict appeared in a flashback within [[Legacy (2006) 21|issue 21]] of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''.<ref name="Legacy 21" /> The character was named by writer [[John Ostrander]] after the [[Jedi Council Forums]] user ''AdmiralNick22'', an enthusiastic fan of the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="dearinternet">{{Twitter|AdmiralNick22|status/1310695438807257088|AdmiralNick22|quote=Re-reading Star Wars: Legacy. I can still remember the sheer joygasm I experienced when I got this PM from John Ostrander over on TF.N.|archivedate=20200929010152}}</ref>
